# Country scope. Clears only disposable process state.
zhx_academy_clear_expulsion_state = {
    remove_country_modifier = zhx_academy_expulsion_campaign
    clr_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_chongli
    clr_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_minglun
    clr_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_yifa
    clr_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_xunming
    clr_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_jianai
    clr_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_shangtong
    clr_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_xuantong
    clr_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_baopu
    clr_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_miaosuan
    clr_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_zhisheng
    clr_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_baihe
    clr_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_lianheng
}

# Country scope. Clears one disposable deadline-result presentation flag.
zhx_academy_clear_result_flags = {
    clr_country_flag = zhx_academy_result_protected
    clr_country_flag = zhx_academy_result_chongli
    clr_country_flag = zhx_academy_result_minglun

# Country scope. Player withdrawal; the active academy never moves.
zhx_academy_withdraw_current_expulsion = {
    if = {
        limit = { ai = no }
        random_owned_province = {
            limit = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_under_expulsion }
            save_global_event_target_as = zhx_academy_withdrawn_province
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_chongli }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_result_chongli
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_minglun }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_result_minglun
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_yifa }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_result_yifa
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_xunming }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_result_xunming
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_jianai }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_result_jianai
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_shangtong }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_result_shangtong
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_xuantong }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_result_xuantong
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_baopu }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_result_baopu
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_miaosuan }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_result_miaosuan
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_zhisheng }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_result_zhisheng
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_baihe }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_result_baihe
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_lianheng }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_result_lianheng
        }
    }
    every_owned_province = {
        limit = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_under_expulsion }
        remove_province_modifier = zhx_academy_under_expulsion
    }
    zhx_academy_clear_expulsion_state = yes
    add_country_modifier = {
        name = zhx_academy_expulsion_cooldown
        duration = 3650
    }
    zhx_refresh_academy_country_effects = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            ai = no
            has_saved_global_event_target = zhx_academy_withdrawn_province
        }
        country_event = { id = zhx_academy.230 }
    }
}

# Province scope during on_province_owner_change; FROM is the old owner.
# Identity pairing cannot rely on a temporary modifier surviving transfer.
zhx_academy_cancel_expulsion_on_owner_change = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            FROM = { exists = yes }
            OR = {
            AND = {
                has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_chongli
                FROM = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_chongli }
            }
            AND = {
                has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_minglun
                FROM = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_minglun }
            }
            AND = {
                has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_yifa
                FROM = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_yifa }
            }
            AND = {
                has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_xunming
                FROM = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_xunming }
            }
            AND = {
                has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_jianai
                FROM = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_jianai }
            }
            AND = {
                has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_shangtong
                FROM = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_shangtong }
            }
            AND = {
                has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_xuantong
                FROM = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_xuantong }
            }
            AND = {
                has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_baopu
                FROM = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_baopu }
            }
            AND = {
                has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_miaosuan
                FROM = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_miaosuan }
            }
            AND = {
                has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_zhisheng
                FROM = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_zhisheng }
            }
            AND = {
                has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_baihe
                FROM = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_baihe }
            }
            AND = {
                has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_lianheng
                FROM = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_lianheng }
            }
            }
        }
        FROM = { zhx_academy_clear_expulsion_state = yes }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_under_expulsion }
        remove_province_modifier = zhx_academy_under_expulsion
    }
}

zhx_academy_outrage_ru = {
    every_country = {
        limit = {
            exists = yes
            NOT = { tag = ROOT }
            zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
            OR = {
                has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_ru
                has_country_modifier = zhx_ru_invited_scholar_modifier
            }
        }
        add_opinion = {
            who = ROOT
            modifier = zhx_opinion_expelled_our_school
        }
        add_aggressive_expansion = {
            who = ROOT
            value = 10
            apply_calc = no
        }
    }
}

zhx_academy_begin_expulsion_chongli = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            is_at_war = no
            stability = 1
            adm_power = 30
            NOT = { has_country_modifier = zhx_academy_expulsion_campaign }
            NOT = { has_country_modifier = zhx_academy_expulsion_cooldown }
            zhx_academy_has_unprotected_chongli = yes
        }
        add_adm_power = -30
        add_stability = -1
        add_prestige = -5
        add_country_modifier = {
            name = zhx_academy_expulsion_campaign
            duration = 1100
        }
        set_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_chongli
        random_owned_province = {
            limit = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_chongli }
            add_province_modifier = {
                name = zhx_academy_under_expulsion
                duration = 1100
            }
            province_event = { id = zhx_academy.200 days = 1095 }
        }
        zhx_academy_outrage_ru = yes
        zhx_refresh_academy_country_effects = yes
    }
}

        random_owned_province = {
            limit = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_baihe }
            add_province_modifier = {
                name = zhx_academy_under_expulsion
                duration = 1100
            }
            province_event = { id = zhx_academy.200 days = 1095 }
        }
        zhx_academy_outrage_zongheng = yes
        zhx_refresh_academy_country_effects = yes
    }
}
zhx_academy_begin_expulsion_lianheng = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            is_at_war = no
            stability = 1
            adm_power = 30
            NOT = { has_country_modifier = zhx_academy_expulsion_campaign }
            NOT = { has_country_modifier = zhx_academy_expulsion_cooldown }
            zhx_academy_has_unprotected_lianheng = yes
        }
        add_adm_power = -30
        add_stability = -1
        add_prestige = -5
        add_country_modifier = {
            name = zhx_academy_expulsion_campaign
            duration = 1100
        }
        set_country_flag = zhx_academy_expelling_lianheng
        random_owned_province = {
            limit = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_lianheng }
            add_province_modifier = {
                name = zhx_academy_under_expulsion
                duration = 1100
            }
            province_event = { id = zhx_academy.200 days = 1095 }
        }
        zhx_academy_outrage_zongheng = yes
        zhx_refresh_academy_country_effects = yes
    }
}

# Country scope. Used only after the strict AI annual gate passes.
zhx_academy_begin_random_unprotected_expulsion = {
    random_owned_province = {
        limit = { zhx_academy_is_unprotected_active_province = yes }
        if = {
            limit = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_chongli }
            owner = { zhx_academy_begin_expulsion_chongli = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_minglun }
            owner = { zhx_academy_begin_expulsion_minglun = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_yifa }
            owner = { zhx_academy_begin_expulsion_yifa = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_xunming }
            owner = { zhx_academy_begin_expulsion_xunming = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_jianai }
            owner = { zhx_academy_begin_expulsion_jianai = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_shangtong }
            owner = { zhx_academy_begin_expulsion_shangtong = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_xuantong }
            owner = { zhx_academy_begin_expulsion_xuantong = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_baopu }
            owner = { zhx_academy_begin_expulsion_baopu = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_miaosuan }
            owner = { zhx_academy_begin_expulsion_miaosuan = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_zhisheng }
            owner = { zhx_academy_begin_expulsion_zhisheng = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_baihe }
            owner = { zhx_academy_begin_expulsion_baihe = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_lianheng }
            owner = { zhx_academy_begin_expulsion_lianheng = yes }
        }
    }
}

zhx_academy_finish_expulsion_chongli = {
    owner = { save_event_target_as = zhx_academy_expeller }
    remove_province_modifier = zhx_academy_chongli
    remove_province_modifier = zhx_academy_under_expulsion
    add_permanent_province_modifier = {
        name = zhx_academy_ruins_chongli
        duration = -1
    }
    set_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_chongli
    owner = {
        if = {
            limit = { ai = no }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_result_chongli
            country_event = { id = zhx_academy.220 }
        }
        zhx_academy_clear_expulsion_state = yes
        zhx_refresh_academy_country_effects = yes
    }
    zhx_academy_offer_refuge_chongli = yes
}

zhx_academy_offer_refuge_chongli = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            any_country = {
                exists = yes
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                zhx_academy_has_empty_host_province = yes
                NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending }
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller }
                has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_ru
            }
        }
        random_country = {
            limit = {
                exists = yes
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                zhx_academy_has_empty_host_province = yes
                NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending }
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller }
                has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_ru
            }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_chongli
            country_event = { id = zhx_academy.210 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            any_country = {
                exists = yes
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                zhx_academy_has_empty_host_province = yes
                NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending }
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller }
                has_country_modifier = zhx_ru_invited_scholar_modifier
            }
        }
        random_country = {
            limit = {
                exists = yes
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                zhx_academy_has_empty_host_province = yes
                NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending }
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller }
                has_country_modifier = zhx_ru_invited_scholar_modifier
            }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_chongli
            country_event = { id = zhx_academy.210 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            any_country = {
                exists = yes
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                zhx_academy_has_empty_host_province = yes
                NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending }
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller }
                has_opinion = { who = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller value = 50 }
            }
        }
        random_country = {
            limit = {
                exists = yes
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                zhx_academy_has_empty_host_province = yes
                NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending }
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller }
                has_opinion = { who = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller value = 50 }
            }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_chongli
            country_event = { id = zhx_academy.210 }
        }
    }
}

zhx_academy_install_chongli = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            any_owned_province = {
                zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes
                development = 20
            }
        }
        random_owned_province = {
            limit = {
                zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes
                development = 20
            }
            add_permanent_province_modifier = {
                name = zhx_academy_chongli
                duration = -1
            }
            if = {
                limit = { owner = { ai = no } }
                save_global_event_target_as = zhx_academy_arrival_province
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            any_owned_province = {
                zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes
                development = 12
            }
        }
        random_owned_province = {
            limit = {
                zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes
                development = 12
            }
            add_permanent_province_modifier = {
                name = zhx_academy_chongli
                duration = -1
            }
            if = {
                limit = { owner = { ai = no } }
                save_global_event_target_as = zhx_academy_arrival_province
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        random_owned_province = {
            limit = { zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes }
            add_permanent_province_modifier = {
                name = zhx_academy_chongli
                duration = -1
            }
            if = {
                limit = { owner = { ai = no } }
                save_global_event_target_as = zhx_academy_arrival_province
            }
        }
    }
    clr_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_chongli
    zhx_academy_clear_refuge_offer_flags = yes
    zhx_refresh_academy_country_effects = yes
}

                NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending }
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller }
                has_opinion = { who = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller value = 50 }
            }
        }
        random_country = {
            limit = {
                exists = yes
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                zhx_academy_has_empty_host_province = yes
                NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending }
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller }
                has_opinion = { who = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller value = 50 }
            }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_yifa
            country_event = { id = zhx_academy.210 }
        }
    }
}

zhx_academy_install_yifa = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            any_owned_province = {
                zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes
                development = 20
            }
        }
        random_owned_province = {
            limit = {
                zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes
                development = 20
            }
            add_permanent_province_modifier = {
                name = zhx_academy_yifa
                duration = -1
            }
            if = {
                limit = { owner = { ai = no } }
                save_global_event_target_as = zhx_academy_arrival_province
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            any_owned_province = {
                zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes
                development = 12
            }
        }
        random_owned_province = {
            limit = {
                zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes
                development = 12
            }
            add_permanent_province_modifier = {
                name = zhx_academy_yifa
                duration = -1
            }
            if = {
                limit = { owner = { ai = no } }
                save_global_event_target_as = zhx_academy_arrival_province
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        random_owned_province = {
            limit = { zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes }
            add_permanent_province_modifier = {
                name = zhx_academy_yifa
                duration = -1
            }
            if = {
                limit = { owner = { ai = no } }
                save_global_event_target_as = zhx_academy_arrival_province
            }
        }
    }
    clr_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_yifa
    zhx_academy_clear_refuge_offer_flags = yes
    zhx_refresh_academy_country_effects = yes
}

zhx_academy_finish_expulsion_xunming = {
    owner = { save_event_target_as = zhx_academy_expeller }
    remove_province_modifier = zhx_academy_xunming
    remove_province_modifier = zhx_academy_under_expulsion
    add_permanent_province_modifier = {
        name = zhx_academy_ruins_xunming
        duration = -1
    }
    set_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_xunming
    owner = {
        if = {
            limit = { ai = no }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_result_xunming
            country_event = { id = zhx_academy.220 }
        }
        zhx_academy_clear_expulsion_state = yes
        zhx_refresh_academy_country_effects = yes
    }
    zhx_academy_offer_refuge_xunming = yes
}

zhx_academy_offer_refuge_xunming = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            any_country = {
                exists = yes
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes

                NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending }
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller }
                has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_fa
            }

                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                zhx_academy_has_empty_host_province = yes

            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_xunming

            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_shangtong
            country_event = { id = zhx_academy.210 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            any_country = {
                exists = yes
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                zhx_academy_has_empty_host_province = yes
                NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending }
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller }
                has_country_modifier = zhx_mo_invited_scholar_modifier
            }
        }
        random_country = {
            limit = {
                exists = yes
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                zhx_academy_has_empty_host_province = yes
                NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending }
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller }
                has_country_modifier = zhx_mo_invited_scholar_modifier
            }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_shangtong
            country_event = { id = zhx_academy.210 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            any_country = {
                exists = yes
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                zhx_academy_has_empty_host_province = yes
                NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending }
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller }
                has_opinion = { who = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller value = 50 }
            }
        }
        random_country = {
            limit = {
                exists = yes
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                zhx_academy_has_empty_host_province = yes
                NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending }
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller }
                has_opinion = { who = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller value = 50 }
            }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_shangtong
            country_event = { id = zhx_academy.210 }
        }
    }

zhx_academy_install_shangtong = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            any_owned_province = {
                zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes
                development = 20
            }
        }
        random_owned_province = {
            limit = {
                zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes
                development = 20
            }
            add_permanent_province_modifier = {
                name = zhx_academy_shangtong
                duration = -1
            }
            if = {
                limit = { owner = { ai = no } }
                save_global_event_target_as = zhx_academy_arrival_province
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            any_owned_province = {
                zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes
                development = 12
            }
        }
        random_owned_province = {
            limit = {
                zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes
                development = 12
            }
            add_permanent_province_modifier = {
                name = zhx_academy_shangtong
                duration = -1
            }
            if = {
                limit = { owner = { ai = no } }
                save_global_event_target_as = zhx_academy_arrival_province
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        random_owned_province = {
            limit = { zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes }
            add_permanent_province_modifier = {
                name = zhx_academy_shangtong
                duration = -1
            }
            if = {
                limit = { owner = { ai = no } }
                save_global_event_target_as = zhx_academy_arrival_province
            }
        }
    }
    clr_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_shangtong
    zhx_academy_clear_refuge_offer_flags = yes
    zhx_refresh_academy_country_effects = yes
}

zhx_academy_finish_expulsion_xuantong = {
    owner = { save_event_target_as = zhx_academy_expeller }
    remove_province_modifier = zhx_academy_xuantong
    remove_province_modifier = zhx_academy_under_expulsion
    add_permanent_province_modifier = {
        name = zhx_academy_ruins_xuantong
        duration = -1
    }
    set_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_xuantong
    owner = {
        if = {
            limit = { ai = no }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_result_xuantong
            country_event = { id = zhx_academy.220 }
        }
        zhx_academy_clear_expulsion_state = yes
        zhx_refresh_academy_country_effects = yes
    }
    zhx_academy_offer_refuge_xuantong = yes
}

    add_permanent_province_modifier = {
        name = zhx_academy_ruins_miaosuan
        duration = -1
    }
    set_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_miaosuan
    owner = {
        if = {
            limit = { ai = no }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_result_miaosuan
            country_event = { id = zhx_academy.220 }
        }
        zhx_academy_clear_expulsion_state = yes
        zhx_refresh_academy_country_effects = yes
    }
    zhx_academy_offer_refuge_miaosuan = yes
}

zhx_academy_offer_refuge_miaosuan = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            any_country = {
                exists = yes
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                zhx_academy_has_empty_host_province = yes
                NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending }
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller }
                has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_bing
            }
        }
        random_country = {
            limit = {
                exists = yes
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                zhx_academy_has_empty_host_province = yes
                NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending }
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller }
                has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_bing
            }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_miaosuan
            country_event = { id = zhx_academy.210 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            any_country = {
                exists = yes
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                zhx_academy_has_empty_host_province = yes
                NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending }
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller }
                has_country_modifier = zhx_bing_invited_scholar_modifier
            }
        }
        random_country = {
            limit = {
                exists = yes
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                zhx_academy_has_empty_host_province = yes
                NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending }
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller }
                has_country_modifier = zhx_bing_invited_scholar_modifier
            }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_miaosuan
            country_event = { id = zhx_academy.210 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            any_country = {
                exists = yes
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                zhx_academy_has_empty_host_province = yes
                NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending }
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller }
                has_opinion = { who = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller value = 50 }
            }
        }
        random_country = {
            limit = {
                exists = yes
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                zhx_academy_has_empty_host_province = yes
                NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending }
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller }
                has_opinion = { who = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller value = 50 }
            }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_miaosuan
            country_event = { id = zhx_academy.210 }
        }
    }
}

zhx_academy_install_miaosuan = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            any_owned_province = {
                zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes
                development = 20
            }
        }
        random_owned_province = {
            limit = {
                zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes
                development = 20
            }
            add_permanent_province_modifier = {
                name = zhx_academy_miaosuan
                duration = -1
            }
            if = {
                limit = { owner = { ai = no } }
                save_global_event_target_as = zhx_academy_arrival_province
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            any_owned_province = {
                zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes
                development = 12
            }
        }
        random_owned_province = {
            limit = {
                zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes
                development = 12
            }
            add_permanent_province_modifier = {
                name = zhx_academy_miaosuan
                duration = -1
            }
            if = {
                limit = { owner = { ai = no } }
                save_global_event_target_as = zhx_academy_arrival_province
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        random_owned_province = {
            limit = { zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes }
            add_permanent_province_modifier = {
                name = zhx_academy_miaosuan
                duration = -1
            }
            if = {
                limit = { owner = { ai = no } }
                save_global_event_target_as = zhx_academy_arrival_province
            }
        }
    }
    clr_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_miaosuan
    zhx_academy_clear_refuge_offer_flags = yes
    zhx_refresh_academy_country_effects = yes
}

zhx_academy_finish_expulsion_zhisheng = {
    owner = { save_event_target_as = zhx_academy_expeller }
    remove_province_modifier = zhx_academy_zhisheng
    remove_province_modifier = zhx_academy_under_expulsion
    add_permanent_province_modifier = {
        name = zhx_academy_ruins_zhisheng
        duration = -1
    }
    set_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_zhisheng
    owner = {
        if = {
            limit = { ai = no }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_result_zhisheng
            country_event = { id = zhx_academy.220 }
        }
        zhx_academy_clear_expulsion_state = yes
        zhx_refresh_academy_country_effects = yes
    }
    zhx_academy_offer_refuge_zhisheng = yes
}

    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            any_owned_province = {
                zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes
                development = 12
            }
        }
        random_owned_province = {
            limit = {
                zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes
                development = 12
            }
            add_permanent_province_modifier = {
                name = zhx_academy_baihe
                duration = -1
            }
            if = {
                limit = { owner = { ai = no } }
                save_global_event_target_as = zhx_academy_arrival_province
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        random_owned_province = {
            limit = { zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes }
            add_permanent_province_modifier = {
                name = zhx_academy_baihe
                duration = -1
            }
            if = {
                limit = { owner = { ai = no } }
                save_global_event_target_as = zhx_academy_arrival_province
            }
        }
    }
    clr_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_baihe
    zhx_academy_clear_refuge_offer_flags = yes
    zhx_refresh_academy_country_effects = yes
}

zhx_academy_finish_expulsion_lianheng = {
    owner = { save_event_target_as = zhx_academy_expeller }
    remove_province_modifier = zhx_academy_lianheng
    remove_province_modifier = zhx_academy_under_expulsion
    add_permanent_province_modifier = {
        name = zhx_academy_ruins_lianheng
        duration = -1
    }
    set_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_lianheng
    owner = {
        if = {
            limit = { ai = no }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_result_lianheng
            country_event = { id = zhx_academy.220 }
        }
        zhx_academy_clear_expulsion_state = yes
        zhx_refresh_academy_country_effects = yes
    }
    zhx_academy_offer_refuge_lianheng = yes
}

zhx_academy_offer_refuge_lianheng = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            any_country = {
                exists = yes
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                zhx_academy_has_empty_host_province = yes
                NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending }
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller }
                has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_zongheng
            }
        }
        random_country = {
            limit = {
                exists = yes
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                zhx_academy_has_empty_host_province = yes
                NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending }
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller }
                has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_zongheng
            }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_lianheng
            country_event = { id = zhx_academy.210 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            any_country = {
                exists = yes
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                zhx_academy_has_empty_host_province = yes
                NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending }
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller }
                has_country_modifier = zhx_zongheng_invited_scholar_modifier
            }
        }
        random_country = {
            limit = {
                exists = yes
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                zhx_academy_has_empty_host_province = yes
                NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending }
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller }
                has_country_modifier = zhx_zongheng_invited_scholar_modifier
            }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_lianheng
            country_event = { id = zhx_academy.210 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            any_country = {
                exists = yes
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                zhx_academy_has_empty_host_province = yes
                NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending }
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller }
                has_opinion = { who = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller value = 50 }
            }
        }
        random_country = {
            limit = {
                exists = yes
                zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
                zhx_academy_has_empty_host_province = yes
                NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending }
                NOT = { tag = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller }
                has_opinion = { who = event_target:zhx_academy_expeller value = 50 }
            }
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_pending
            set_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_lianheng
            country_event = { id = zhx_academy.210 }
        }
    }
}

zhx_academy_install_lianheng = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            any_owned_province = {
                zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes
                development = 20
            }
        }
        random_owned_province = {
            limit = {
                zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes
                development = 20
            }
            add_permanent_province_modifier = {
                name = zhx_academy_lianheng
                duration = -1
            }
            if = {
                limit = { owner = { ai = no } }
                save_global_event_target_as = zhx_academy_arrival_province
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            any_owned_province = {
                zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes
                development = 12
            }
        }
        random_owned_province = {
            limit = {
                zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes
                development = 12
            }
            add_permanent_province_modifier = {
                name = zhx_academy_lianheng
                duration = -1
            }
            if = {
                limit = { owner = { ai = no } }
                save_global_event_target_as = zhx_academy_arrival_province
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        random_owned_province = {
            limit = { zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes }
            add_permanent_province_modifier = {
                name = zhx_academy_lianheng
                duration = -1
            }
            if = {
                limit = { owner = { ai = no } }
                save_global_event_target_as = zhx_academy_arrival_province
            }
        }
    }
    clr_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_lianheng
    zhx_academy_clear_refuge_offer_flags = yes
    zhx_refresh_academy_country_effects = yes
}

# Candidate country scope. Exactly one offer flag should be set.
zhx_academy_accept_pending_offer = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_chongli }
        zhx_academy_install_chongli = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_minglun }
        zhx_academy_install_minglun = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_yifa }
        zhx_academy_install_yifa = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_xunming }
        zhx_academy_install_xunming = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_jianai }
        zhx_academy_install_jianai = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_shangtong }
        zhx_academy_install_shangtong = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_xuantong }
        zhx_academy_install_xuantong = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_baopu }
        zhx_academy_install_baopu = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_miaosuan }
        zhx_academy_install_miaosuan = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_zhisheng }
        zhx_academy_install_zhisheng = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_baihe }
        zhx_academy_install_baihe = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_academy_refuge_offer_lianheng }
        zhx_academy_install_lianheng = yes
    }
}

# Tianzi country scope. Each dormant identity gets an independent
# ten-percent yearly revival attempt; active truth repairs stale flags.
zhx_academy_attempt_dormant_revivals = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_chongli
            any_country = {
                any_owned_province = {
                    has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_chongli
                }
            }
        }
        clr_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_chongli
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_chongli
        }
        random = {
            chance = 10
            zhx_academy_offer_revival_chongli = yes
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_minglun
            any_country = {
                any_owned_province = {
                    has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_minglun
                }
            }
        }
        clr_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_minglun
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_minglun
        }
        random = {
            chance = 10
            zhx_academy_offer_revival_minglun = yes
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_yifa
            any_country = {
                any_owned_province = {
                    has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_yifa
                }
            }
        }
        clr_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_yifa
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_yifa
        }
        random = {
            chance = 10
            zhx_academy_offer_revival_yifa = yes
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_xunming
            any_country = {
                any_owned_province = {
                    has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_xunming
                }
            }
        }
        clr_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_xunming
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_xunming
        }
        random = {
            chance = 10
            zhx_academy_offer_revival_xunming = yes
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_jianai
            any_country = {
                any_owned_province = {
                    has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_jianai
                }
            }
        }
        clr_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_jianai
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_jianai
        }
        random = {
            chance = 10
            zhx_academy_offer_revival_jianai = yes
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_shangtong
            any_country = {
                any_owned_province = {
                    has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_shangtong
                }
            }
        }
        clr_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_shangtong
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_shangtong
        }
        random = {
            chance = 10
            zhx_academy_offer_revival_shangtong = yes
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_xuantong
            any_country = {
                any_owned_province = {
                    has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_xuantong
                }
            }
        }
        clr_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_xuantong
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_xuantong

        random = {
            chance = 10

        }

    if = {

            any_country = {

                    has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_baopu
                }
            }
        }
        clr_global_flag = zhx_academy_dormant_baopu

    else_if = {
